mapper.select: SELECT wallet_id AS walletId, freelancer_id AS freelancerId, account_id AS accountId, balance, total_earned AS totalEarned FROM freelancer_wallets WHERE freelancer_id = #{freelancerId}

SELECT wallet_history_id AS walletHistoryId, wallet_id AS walletId, io_type AS ioType, amount AS amount, balance AS balance, summary AS summary, DATE_FORMAT(created_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS createdAt FROM wallet_histories WHERE wallet_id = #{walletId} ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
